modes.description: The end of a place name or a book citation, just before a parenthesis or comma.

card.writes: It promotes opening brackets, parentheses and link openers, so a parenthetical or citation tends to come next.
card.plain: It fires inside a drug name when the name is complete enough that a bracketed brand name or reference may follow.
